programBoundary.purpose: Read Rakuten Japan marketplace listings and optionally request an Ichiba affiliate URL using a caller-owned Rakuten Affiliate ID.

accessKey.transport: accessKey HTTP header preferred; official documentation also permits query parameter
accessKey.clientBehavior: sent only as the accessKey header; never appended to a URL or receipt

affiliateId.source: explicit caller supplied Rakuten Affiliate ID only
affiliateId.result: affiliateUrl may be present only when this value is supplied

applicationRegistration.perAppCredentials: Application ID and access key are issued separately for each app and must be paired.
applicationRegistration.affiliateIdCardinality: The official usage guide says one Affiliate ID is issued per developer and may be used across registered apps.

itemSearch.versionChangeBoundary: The current July version and previous April version both document required applicationId plus accessKey. The client pins the current versioned path and does not fall back to a legacy route.
itemSearch.requiredSelector: At least one of keyword, shopCode, itemCode, or genreId.

selectors.keyword: UTF-8 text, max 128 single-byte characters; multiple terms default to AND.
selectors.shopCode: The shop path code from Rakuten shop URLs.
selectors.itemCode: Marketplace item key in shopCode:itemIdentifier form; usable for exact item detail lookup through this same Search API.

filters.maxPrice: Positive integer JPY; less than 999999999 and greater than minPrice.

price.basis: listing-level API itemPrice; it is not asserted to be a selected SKU/variant price
price.normalizedAmount: decimal string with no fraction (Rakuten Ichiba JPY amount)
price.priceBasis: Preserved separately from itemPrice as {field,meaning}: itemPriceBaseField may be item_price_min1 (all-item minimum basis), item_price_min2 (searchable-item minimum basis), item_price_min3 (purchasable-item minimum basis), or null/not specified.
price.rateMetadata: affiliateRate is preserved as an item-specific API percentage when returned; the client has no fixed commission assumption.

response.identity: Each result is checked so the shopCode prefix of itemCode matches the returned shopCode. Detail lookup additionally matches the requested itemCode exactly.
response.canonicalUrl: A clean HTTPS Rakuten merchant URL is returned only when itemUrl itself or a static pc/m target in the API-returned itemUrl/affiliateUrl has a recognized Rakuten Ichiba item host, a path beginning with the row's shopCode, and an exact path segment matching the itemCode suffix. This is a literal match; the adapter does not assume a transformed URL slug. Query and fragment are removed. If the URL does not expose the exact item key, canonicalUrl is null and targetVerified is false while affiliateUrl remains separate.
response.affiliateTargetHandling: affiliateId may make itemUrl equal affiliateUrl. When a static pc/m target is present, it is inspected without fetching/following the affiliate URL. Redirect-only or unrecognized targets remain unverified; no URL is synthesized.
response.sourceNote: The current Item Search page documents the itemUrl/affiliateUrl relation; the current Rakuten Product Search API documents the affiliate link shape with pc and m targets. This implementation only parses target parameters actually present in Item Search API response URLs; it does not construct an affiliate URL from that other API's format.

genreSearch.authentication: Same required accessKey header as the item-search API.

clientImplementation.factory: createRakutenIchibaClient({ applicationId, accessKey, affiliateId?, fetchImpl?, now? })
clientImplementation.delivery: Pure direct HTTPS GET; manual redirects; cookies omitted; credentials injected in process memory.

termsAndAttribution.note: Rakuten Web Services says apps using its API must display one of the provided branding/credit badges using its HTML snippet unchanged.
